def solve(g):
    from collections import Counter
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # separator color: appears as full rows/cols
    sep=None
    for v in {x for row in g for x in row}:
        if any(all(x==v for x in row) for row in g) or any(all(row[j]==v for row in g) for j in range(W)):
            sep=v; break
    R=groups({i for i,row in enumerate(g) if all(x==sep for x in row)},H)
    C=groups({j for j in range(W) if all(row[j]==sep for row in g)},W)
    flat=[g[i][j] for BR in R for BC in C for i in BR for j in BC]
    bg=Counter(flat).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker=[v for v in Counter(flat) if v!=bg][0]
    cnt=[[sum(g[i][j]==marker for i in BR for j in BC) for BC in C] for BR in R]
    mx=max(v for row in cnt for v in row)
    return [[1 if v==mx else bg for v in row] for row in cnt]

def groups(idx, n):

    out, cur = [], []

def separator_color(grid):
